Result statuses and the historic label are kept by that script's rules. 10 further changes were held back because the record's own sentences would contradict the new status; they are listed below.
notes: 6,409 registrations read for 6,527 trial records; 2 not returned. Registry statuses today: recruiting 3010, active not recruiting 1502, completed 911, not yet recruiting 560, unknown 205, terminated 169, enrolling by invitation 22, withdrawn 17, suspended 6, approved for marketing 4, no longer available 1.

A status is corrected by the generators (see "Changed by the run itself"). The text of a record is not: where a row quotes words such as "recruiting" or "awaited", the record still says them.
